steps.text:
The clock and the cache use the same units, so this looks like a boundary error rather than a timing problem. I should change the comparison and leave the clock alone.

The test already names the exact deadline. Keeping that test small makes the intended behaviour easier to read. A second check just before the deadline will show that the cache still returns a value while it is fresh.

I’ll make the comparison strict, ask a worker to check the fixture, and then read the result of the background run. If it fails for another reason, I’ll inspect that output before changing anything else.
